The INFRUCTUEUX blocks (18033024 RES-3/4/5/9/12/13, 18242004 RES-2..6) are each one lot's no-award block, still that lot's (the 5362479 'déclaré sans suite' reading); their 'winner' is the word 'infructueux' parsed as an organization, a party-data defect outside lot placement. The relaunch awards (18242004 RES-1 Land Rover, 18527820 RES-1 Volvo, 18527875 RES-1/2 Mercedes) name their relaunched lot
